question: **Select the misspelt word.**
solution:
The erroneous spelling "**presentor**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's look at the correct spelling and meaning of the word.
 
• **Presenter**: a person who introduces and appears in a television or radio programme.
 
 
• **Example**: The news presenter
